	-- No yield between bridge, capture/hide and publication\046
	if not self:_bridge(folder) then
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end

		local part = item :: BasePart
		self\046_originals[part] = part\046LocalTransparencyModifier
		part\046LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end

	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)

end

function CornBackdropController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	if not self\046_renderer or typeof(self\046_renderer\046UseBackdropReady) ~= "function" then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false

	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Backdrop needs a prepared BasePart template compatible with near-field coverage; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end

		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
		or not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) < 0\0469999
		or field\046Size\046X <= 0
		or field\046Size\046Z <= 0

		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or not template:IsA("BasePart")
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		or not staticArt(template)

			"Owned horizontal field and prepared static art unavailable; saved overview preserved"

		\046\046 tostring(bounds)
		\046\046 "/"
		\046\046 tostring(size)

		and self\046_field == field
		and self\046_template == template
		and self\046_signature == signature
		and folder
		and folder\046Parent == map

		math\046floor(maxColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math\046floor(maxRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE

		self:_warn("Full-field grid exceeds the 20000 plant cap; saved overview preserved")

	self\046_minColumn, self\046_maxColumn = minColumn, maxColumn
	self\046_minRow, self\046_maxRow = minRow, maxRow
	self\046_column, self\046_row = minColumn, minRow
	self\046_fieldFrame = field\046CFrame
	self\046_fieldSize = field\046Size

	folder\046Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("Stride", STRIDE)
	folder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", STRIDE * CornLayout\046Spacing)
	folder:SetAttribute("MaxPlants", MAX_PLANTS)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder\046Parent = map
	self\046_folder = folder
	self\046_lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_advance()
	self\046_column += STRIDE
	if self\046_column > self\046_maxColumn then
		self\046_column = self\046_minColumn
		self\046_row += STRIDE
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_buildStep()
	local folder, field, template, exclusions =
		self\046_folder, self\046_field, self\046_template, self\046_exclusions
	if not folder or not field or not template or not exclusions or self\046_ready then
		return
	end
	if
		folder\046Parent ~= self\046_map
		or not owned(folder)
		or field\046CFrame ~= self\046_fieldFrame
		or field\046Size ~= self\046_fieldSize
	then
		self:_clear()
		self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC

	local epoch, start = self\046_epoch, self\046_clock()
	local created = 0
	while
		self\046_epoch == epoch
		and self\046_row <= self\046_maxRow
		and created < CLONE_BUDGET
		and self\046_count < MAX_PLANTS
		and self\046_clock() - start < TIME_BUDGET

			item:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
			item:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item\046Anchored = true
				item\046CanCollide = false
				item\046CanTouch = false
				item\046CanQuery = false

			CornLayout\046PivotForPlant(
				plant,
				position,
				CornLayout\046CellYaw(column, row) + self\046_fieldYaw
			)
		)

		created += 1
		self\046_count += 1
	end

	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", created)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", self\046_clock() - start)

		if not self:_publish() then
			local failed = self\046_signature
			self:_clear()
			self\046_failedSignature = failed
		end
	end
end

	self\046_pollElapsed += delta
	if self\046_pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self\046_pollElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveInputs()
	end

function CornBackdropController:Init(context: any)
	self\046_enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self\046_renderer = context\046Controllers\046CornController
	self\046_connection = nil
	self\046_clock = os\046clock
	self\046_epoch = 0
	self\046_originals = {}
	self\046_ready = false
	self\046_count = 0
	self\046_lastWarning = ""
	self\046_pollElapsed = math\046huge
	self\046_failedSignature = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)

		if not runtime then

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self\046_overviewFolder
	if not folder or self\046_overviewInvalid then

		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self\046_overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self\046_map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self\046_overviewDirty do
		local part = entry\046Part
		if
			part\046Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then

			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return

		for _, key in entry\046Keys do
			local chunk = self\046_chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk\046Done or (self\046_overviewRuntime and chunk\046Lod > 2) then
				covered = false

function CornController:_clearInputs()

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) < 0\0469999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self\046_map == map
		and self\046_field == field
		and self\046_template == template
		and self\046_folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout\046Bounds(template)
	self\046_pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self\046_height = size\046Y
	self\046_map = map
	self\046_field = field
	self\046_template = template
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder\046Parent = map
	self\046_folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props\046
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout\046DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace\046CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera\046CFrame\046Position)\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
		else 0
	if math\046max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self\046_elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self\046_elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self\046_map :: Model
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local folder = self\046_folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self\046_exclusions and self\046_exclusions\046Signature ~= exclusions\046Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self\046_exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout\046GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os\046clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout\046ElevatedRadius else CornLayout\046RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout\046MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self\046_overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self\046_overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= CornLayout\046Spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math\046floor((localRoot\046X - retainRadius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math\046floor((localRoot\046Z - retainRadius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math\046max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math\046min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math\046max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math\046min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot\046X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot\046Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn \046\046 ":" \046\046 chunkRow
			local previous = self\046_chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous\046Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9\046
				end
				table\046insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table\046sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate\046Key] = true
		local chunk = self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key]
		if chunk and chunk\046Lod ~= candidate\046Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk\046Distance = candidate\046Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance\046new("Folder")
			chunkFolder\046Name = "Chunk_" \046\046 candidate\046Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate\046Lod * CornLayout\046Spacing)
			chunkFolder\046Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate\046Key,
				Lod = candidate\046Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate\046MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate\046MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate\046MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate\046MaxRow,
				Column = candidate\046MinColumn,
				Row = candidate\046MinRow,
				Distance = candidate\046Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self\046_queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not chunk\046Done then
			table\046insert(self\046_queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table\046sort(self\046_queue, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self\046_template
	local field = self\046_field
	local exclusions = self\046_exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return

	local began = os\046clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self\046_queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self\046_plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os\046clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC

		local chunk = self\046_queue[1]
		if not chunk\046Alive or chunk\046Done then
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk\046Column
		local row = chunk\046Row
		chunk\046Column += 1
		if chunk\046Column > chunk\046MaxColumn then
			chunk\046Column = chunk\046MinColumn
			chunk\046Row += 1
		end
		if chunk\046Row > chunk\046MaxRow then
			chunk\046Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout\046CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout\046IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout\046Plant
		plant\046Name = "Corn"
		if chunk\046Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table\046insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item\046CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout\046ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout\046PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout\046CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant\046Parent = chunk\046Folder
		chunk\046Count += 1
		self\046_plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self\046_plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self\046_pollElapsed += delta
	if self\046_pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self\046_pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players\046LocalPlayer\046Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self\046_map and self\046_map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot()\046Position - root\046Position)\046Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect\046Name == "Flame" then
								effect\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if self\046_torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math\046clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self\046_torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self\046_torchesEnabled = enabled

	end
end

		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"

	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)

	self\046_enabled = false
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()

		local part = entry\046Part
		if
			part\046Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry\046Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry\046Keys do
			local chunk = self\046_chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk\046Done then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry\046Hidden then
			part\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry\046PreviousModifier
			entry\046Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self\046_overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		chunk\046Alive = false
		chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_chunks = {}
	self\046_queue = {}
	self\046_plantCount = 0
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_folder = nil
	self\046_map = nil
	self\046_field = nil
	self\046_template = nil
	self\046_exclusions = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) < 0\0469999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self\046_map == map
		and self\046_field == field
		and self\046_template == template
		and self\046_folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout\046Bounds(template)
	self\046_pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self\046_height = size\046Y
	self\046_map = map
	self\046_field = field
	self\046_template = template
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder\046Parent = map
	self\046_folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props\046
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self\046_map :: Model
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local folder = self\046_folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self\046_exclusions and self\046_exclusions\046Signature ~= exclusions\046Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self\046_exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout\046GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local groundHeight = localRoot\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
	if groundHeight > 6 then
		self\046_elevatedUntil = os\046clock() + 2
	end
	local radius = if os\046clock() < (self\046_elevatedUntil or 0)
		then CornLayout\046ElevatedRadius
		else CornLayout\046RenderRadius
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math\046floor((localRoot\046X - radius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046X + radius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math\046floor((localRoot\046Z - radius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046Z + radius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math\046max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math\046min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math\046max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math\046min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot\046X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot\046Z) ^ 2
			if distance <= radius * radius then
				table\046insert(desired, {
					Key = chunkColumn \046\046 ":" \046\046 chunkRow,
					Lod = if distance <= CornLayout\046DenseRadius ^ 2
						then 1
						elseif distance <= CornLayout\046MediumRadius ^ 2 then 2
						else 3,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table\046sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate\046Key] = true
		local chunk = self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key]
		if chunk and chunk\046Lod ~= candidate\046Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk\046Distance = candidate\046Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance\046new("Folder")
			chunkFolder\046Name = "Chunk_" \046\046 candidate\046Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate\046Lod * CornLayout\046Spacing)
			chunkFolder\046Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate\046Key,
				Lod = candidate\046Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate\046MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate\046MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate\046MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate\046MaxRow,
				Column = candidate\046MinColumn,
				Row = candidate\046MinRow,
				Distance = candidate\046Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self\046_queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not chunk\046Done then
			table\046insert(self\046_queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table\046sort(self\046_queue, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self\046_template
	local field = self\046_field
	local exclusions = self\046_exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os\046clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self\046_queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self\046_plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os\046clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self\046_queue[1]
		if not chunk\046Alive or chunk\046Done then
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk\046Column
		local row = chunk\046Row
		chunk\046Column += 1
		if chunk\046Column > chunk\046MaxColumn then
			chunk\046Column = chunk\046MinColumn
			chunk\046Row += 1
		end
		if chunk\046Row > chunk\046MaxRow then
			chunk\046Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout\046CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout\046IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout\046Plant
		plant\046Name = "Corn"
		CornLayout\046ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout\046PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout\046CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant\046Parent = chunk\046Folder
		chunk\046Count += 1
		self\046_plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self\046_plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self\046_pollElapsed += delta
	if self\046_pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self\046_pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players\046LocalPlayer\046Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self\046_map and self\046_map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot()\046Position - root\046Position)\046Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect\046Name == "Flame" then
								effect\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if self\046_torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math\046clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self\046_torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self\046_torchesEnabled = enabled
		self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self\046_torchesEnabled = true
	self\046_enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self\046_enabled = false
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController

local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"

function CornController:_warn(message: string)

		self\046_lastWarning = message

	end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field\046CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part\046CFrame)
	local half = part\046Size / 2
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint\046
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger\046
	local padding = CornLayout\046Spacing * 0\04675
	local halfX = math\046abs(relative\046RightVector\046X) * half\046X
		+ math\046abs(relative\046UpVector\046X) * half\046Y
		+ math\046abs(relative\046LookVector\046X) * half\046Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math\046abs(relative\046RightVector\046Z) * half\046X
		+ math\046abs(relative\046UpVector\046Z) * half\046Y
		+ math\046abs(relative\046LookVector\046Z) * half\046Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field\046Size / 2
	local minX = math\046max(relative\046Position\046X - halfX, -fieldHalf\046X)
	local maxX = math\046min(relative\046Position\046X + halfX, fieldHalf\046X)
	local minZ = math\046max(relative\046Position\046Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf\046Z)
	local maxZ = math\046min(relative\046Position\046Z + halfZ, fieldHalf\046Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local offset = CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
	for column = math\046floor((minX + offset) / width), math\046floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math\046floor((minZ + offset) / width), math\046floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table\046insert(keys, column \046\046 ":" \046\046 row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()

		if entry\046Hidden then

				entry\046Part\046LocalTransparencyModifier = entry\046PreviousModifier

function CornController:_invalidateOverview()

	self:_showOverview()

function CornController:_restoreOverview()

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil
		and map ~= nil
		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder\046Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder\046Parent == map
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)
	then
		return false
	end

	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact\046
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	return true
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self\046_map
	local field = self\046_field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then
		folder = backdrop
	end
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	if
		not self\046_overviewInvalid
		and self\046_overviewFolder == folder
		and self\046_overviewFieldFrame == field\046CFrame
		and self\046_overviewFieldSize == field\046Size
	then
		return -- Signals invalidate the index instead of scanning every saved plant every poll\046
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	-- This pass does not yield or change visibility\046 The whole container must be owned\046
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self\046_overviewFolder = folder
	self\046_overviewRuntime = runtime
	self\046_overviewFieldFrame = field\046CFrame
	self\046_overviewFieldSize = field\046Size
	local function invalidate()
		self:_invalidateOverview()
	end
	local function watch(signal: RBXScriptSignal)
		table\046insert(self\046_overviewConnections, signal:Connect(invalidate))
	end
	watch(folder\046ChildAdded)
	watch(folder\046ChildRemoved)
	watch(folder\046AncestryChanged)
	watch(folder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))

		watch(folder\046DescendantRemoving)
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornClientBackdropOwned"))
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ready"))
	end
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
	for _, item in children do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		local entry: OverviewItem = {
			Part = part,
			PreviousModifier = part\046LocalTransparencyModifier,
			Frame = part\046CFrame,
			Size = part\046Size,
			Keys = overviewKeys(field, part),
			Hidden = false,
		}
		self\046_overviewParts[part] = entry
		for _, key in entry\046Keys do
			local items = self\046_overviewByChunk[key]
			if not items then

				self\046_overviewByChunk[key] = items
			end
			table\046insert(items, entry)
		end

		if not runtime then
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
		end
	end
	self\046_overviewInvalid = false
	for key, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if chunk\046Done then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self\046_overviewFolder
	if not folder or self\046_overviewInvalid then

	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self\046_overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self\046_map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return

	for entry in self\046_overviewDirty do
		local part = entry\046Part
		if
			part\046Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry\046Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry\046Keys do
			local chunk = self\046_chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk\046Done or (self\046_overviewRuntime and chunk\046Lod > 2) then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry\046Hidden then
			part\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry\046PreviousModifier
			entry\046Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self\046_overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		chunk\046Alive = false
		chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_chunks = {}
	self\046_queue = {}
	self\046_plantCount = 0
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_folder = nil
	self\046_map = nil
	self\046_field = nil
	self\046_template = nil
	self\046_exclusions = nil
	self\046_elevatedUntil = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) < 0\0469999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self\046_map == map
		and self\046_field == field
		and self\046_template == template
		and self\046_folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout\046Bounds(template)
	self\046_pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self\046_height = size\046Y
	self\046_map = map
	self\046_field = field
	self\046_template = template
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder\046Parent = map
	self\046_folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props\046
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout\046DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace\046CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera\046CFrame\046Position)\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
		else 0
	if math\046max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self\046_elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self\046_elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self\046_map :: Model
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local folder = self\046_folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self\046_exclusions and self\046_exclusions\046Signature ~= exclusions\046Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self\046_exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout\046GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os\046clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout\046ElevatedRadius else CornLayout\046RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout\046MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self\046_overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self\046_overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= CornLayout\046Spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math\046floor((localRoot\046X - retainRadius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math\046floor((localRoot\046Z - retainRadius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math\046max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math\046min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math\046max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math\046min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot\046X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot\046Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn \046\046 ":" \046\046 chunkRow
			local previous = self\046_chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous\046Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9\046
				end
				table\046insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table\046sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate\046Key] = true
		local chunk = self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key]
		if chunk and chunk\046Lod ~= candidate\046Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk\046Distance = candidate\046Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance\046new("Folder")
			chunkFolder\046Name = "Chunk_" \046\046 candidate\046Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate\046Lod * CornLayout\046Spacing)
			chunkFolder\046Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate\046Key,
				Lod = candidate\046Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate\046MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate\046MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate\046MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate\046MaxRow,
				Column = candidate\046MinColumn,
				Row = candidate\046MinRow,
				Distance = candidate\046Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self\046_queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not chunk\046Done then
			table\046insert(self\046_queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table\046sort(self\046_queue, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self\046_template
	local field = self\046_field
	local exclusions = self\046_exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os\046clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self\046_queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self\046_plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os\046clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self\046_queue[1]
		if not chunk\046Alive or chunk\046Done then
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk\046Column
		local row = chunk\046Row
		chunk\046Column += 1
		if chunk\046Column > chunk\046MaxColumn then
			chunk\046Column = chunk\046MinColumn
			chunk\046Row += 1
		end
		if chunk\046Row > chunk\046MaxRow then
			chunk\046Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout\046CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout\046IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout\046Plant
		plant\046Name = "Corn"
		if chunk\046Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table\046insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item\046RenderFidelity = Enum\046RenderFidelity\046Performance
					item\046CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout\046ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout\046PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout\046CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant\046Parent = chunk\046Folder
		chunk\046Count += 1
		self\046_plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self\046_plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self\046_pollElapsed += delta
	if self\046_pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self\046_pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players\046LocalPlayer\046Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self\046_map and self\046_map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot()\046Position - root\046Position)\046Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect\046Name == "Flame" then
								effect\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if self\046_torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math\046clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self\046_torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self\046_torchesEnabled = enabled
		self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self\046_torchesEnabled = true
	self\046_enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self\046_enabled = false
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController

local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"

function CornController:_warn(message: string)

		self\046_lastWarning = message

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field\046CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part\046CFrame)
	local half = part\046Size / 2
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint\046
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger\046
	local padding = CornLayout\046Spacing * 0\04675
	local halfX = math\046abs(relative\046RightVector\046X) * half\046X
		+ math\046abs(relative\046UpVector\046X) * half\046Y
		+ math\046abs(relative\046LookVector\046X) * half\046Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math\046abs(relative\046RightVector\046Z) * half\046X
		+ math\046abs(relative\046UpVector\046Z) * half\046Y
		+ math\046abs(relative\046LookVector\046Z) * half\046Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field\046Size / 2
	local minX = math\046max(relative\046Position\046X - halfX, -fieldHalf\046X)
	local maxX = math\046min(relative\046Position\046X + halfX, fieldHalf\046X)
	local minZ = math\046max(relative\046Position\046Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf\046Z)
	local maxZ = math\046min(relative\046Position\046Z + halfZ, fieldHalf\046Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local offset = CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
	for column = math\046floor((minX + offset) / width), math\046floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math\046floor((minZ + offset) / width), math\046floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table\046insert(keys, column \046\046 ":" \046\046 row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()

	self:_showOverview()

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil

		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder\046Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder\046Parent == map

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean

		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)

	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact\046
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC

function CornController:_bindOverview()

	local field = self\046_field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then

		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self\046_overviewFolder
	if not folder or self\046_overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self\046_overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self\046_map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self\046_overviewDirty do
		local part = entry\046Part
		if
			part\046Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry\046Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry\046Keys do
			local chunk = self\046_chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk\046Done or (self\046_overviewRuntime and chunk\046Lod > 2) then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry\046Hidden then
			part\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry\046PreviousModifier
			entry\046Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self\046_overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		chunk\046Alive = false
		chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_chunks = {}
	self\046_queue = {}
	self\046_plantCount = 0
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_folder = nil
	self\046_map = nil
	self\046_field = nil
	self\046_template = nil
	self\046_exclusions = nil
	self\046_elevatedUntil = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) < 0\0469999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	if
		self\046_map == map
		and self\046_field == field
		and self\046_template == template
		and self\046_folder
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout\046Bounds(template)
	self\046_pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self\046_height = size\046Y
	self\046_map = map
	self\046_field = field
	self\046_template = template
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	folder\046Parent = map
	self\046_folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props\046
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self\046_lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout\046DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace\046CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera\046CFrame\046Position)\046Y + field\046Size\046Y / 2
		else 0
	if math\046max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self\046_elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self\046_elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self\046_map :: Model
	local field = self\046_field :: BasePart
	local folder = self\046_folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self\046_exclusions and self\046_exclusions\046Signature ~= exclusions\046Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self\046_exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout\046GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root\046Position)
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os\046clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout\046ElevatedRadius else CornLayout\046RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout\046MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self\046_overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self\046_overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= CornLayout\046Spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math\046floor((localRoot\046X - retainRadius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math\046floor((localRoot\046Z - retainRadius) / width), math\046floor((localRoot\046Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math\046max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math\046min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math\046max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout\046ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math\046min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout\046ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot\046X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot\046Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn \046\046 ":" \046\046 chunkRow
			local previous = self\046_chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous\046Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9\046
				end
				table\046insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table\046sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > MAX_CHUNKS then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate\046Key] = true
		local chunk = self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key]
		if chunk and chunk\046Lod ~= candidate\046Lod then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk\046Distance = candidate\046Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance\046new("Folder")
			chunkFolder\046Name = "Chunk_" \046\046 candidate\046Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate\046Lod * CornLayout\046Spacing)
			chunkFolder\046Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate\046Key,
				Lod = candidate\046Lod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate\046MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate\046MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate\046MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate\046MaxRow,
				Column = candidate\046MinColumn,
				Row = candidate\046MinRow,
				Distance = candidate\046Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self\046_chunks[candidate\046Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk\046Alive = false
			self\046_plantCount -= chunk\046Count
			chunk\046Folder:Destroy()
			self\046_chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self\046_queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self\046_chunks do
		if not chunk\046Done then
			table\046insert(self\046_queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table\046sort(self\046_queue, function(a, b)
		return if a\046Distance == b\046Distance then a\046Key < b\046Key else a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self\046_template
	local field = self\046_field
	local exclusions = self\046_exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os\046clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	while
		#self\046_queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self\046_plantCount < MAX_PLANTS
		and os\046clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self\046_queue[1]
		if not chunk\046Alive or chunk\046Done then
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk\046Column
		local row = chunk\046Row
		chunk\046Column += 1
		if chunk\046Column > chunk\046MaxColumn then
			chunk\046Column = chunk\046MinColumn
			chunk\046Row += 1
		end
		if chunk\046Row > chunk\046MaxRow then
			chunk\046Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk\046Key)
			table\046remove(self\046_queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk\046Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout\046CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout\046IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout\046Plant
		plant\046Name = "Corn"
		if chunk\046Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table\046insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item\046CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout\046ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		plant:PivotTo(
			CornLayout\046PivotForPlant(plant, position, CornLayout\046CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw)
		)
		plant\046Parent = chunk\046Folder
		chunk\046Count += 1
		self\046_plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self\046_folder then
		self\046_folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self\046_plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self\046_pollElapsed += delta
	if self\046_pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self\046_pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players\046LocalPlayer\046Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self\046_map and self\046_map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot()\046Position - root\046Position)\046Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect\046Enabled = self\046_torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect\046Name == "Flame" then
								effect\046LocalTransparencyModifier = if self\046_torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math\046clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self\046_torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self\046_torchesEnabled = enabled
		self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self\046_torchesEnabled = true
	self\046_enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self\046_enabled = false
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController
"},source="--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local CornLayout = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

type Chunk = {
	Key: string,
	Lod: number,
	Folder: Folder,
	MinColumn: number,
	MaxColumn: number,
	MinRow: number,
	MaxRow: number,
	Column: number,
	Row: number,
	Distance: number,
	Count: number,
	Alive: boolean,
	Done: boolean,
}

type OverviewItem = {
	Part: BasePart,
	PreviousModifier: number,
	Frame: CFrame,
	Size: Vector3,
	Keys: { string },
	Hidden: boolean,
}

local CornController = {
	Name = "CornController",
	Order = 50,
	_enabled = false,
	_connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_map = nil :: Model?,
	_field = nil :: BasePart?,
	_template = nil :: CornLayout\046Plant?,
	_folder = nil :: Folder?,
	_chunks = {} :: { [string]: Chunk },
	_queue = {} :: { Chunk },
	_exclusions = nil :: CornLayout\046Exclusions?,
	_pivotOffset = CFrame\046identity,
	_height = CornLayout\046Height,
	_pollElapsed = math\046huge,
	_plantCount = 0,
	_lastWarning = "",
	_overviewFolder = nil :: Folder?,
	_overviewParts = {} :: { [BasePart]: OverviewItem },
	_overviewByChunk = {} :: { [string]: { OverviewItem } },
	_overviewDirty = {} :: { [OverviewItem]: boolean },
	_overviewFieldFrame = CFrame\046identity,
	_overviewFieldSize = Vector3\046zero,
	_overviewInvalid = true,
	_overviewRuntime = false,
	_overviewConnections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection },
}

local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local POLL_SEC = 0\0463
local CREATE_BUDGET = 18
local CELL_BUDGET = 100
local TIME_BUDGET_SEC = 0\046003
local MAX_CHUNKS = 100
local MAX_PLANTS = 4032
local LOD_HYSTERESIS = 12
local RETAIN_MARGIN = 18
local ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS = 144

function CornController:_warn(message: string)
	if self\046_lastWarning ~= message then
		self\046_lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornController] " \046\046 message)
	end
end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field\046CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part\046CFrame)
	local half = part\046Size / 2
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint\046
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger\046
	local padding = CornLayout\046Spacing * 0\04675
	local halfX = math\046abs(relative\046RightVector\046X) * half\046X
		+ math\046abs(relative\046UpVector\046X) * half\046Y
		+ math\046abs(relative\046LookVector\046X) * half\046Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math\046abs(relative\046RightVector\046Z) * half\046X
		+ math\046abs(relative\046UpVector\046Z) * half\046Y
		+ math\046abs(relative\046LookVector\046Z) * half\046Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field\046Size / 2
	local minX = math\046max(relative\046Position\046X - halfX, -fieldHalf\046X)
	local maxX = math\046min(relative\046Position\046X + halfX, fieldHalf\046X)
	local minZ = math\046max(relative\046Position\046Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf\046Z)
	local maxZ = math\046min(relative\046Position\046Z + halfZ, fieldHalf\046Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = CornLayout\046Spacing * CornLayout\046ChunkCells
	local offset = CornLayout\046Spacing / 2
	for column = math\046floor((minX + offset) / width), math\046floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math\046floor((minZ + offset) / width), math\046floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table\046insert(keys, column \046\046 ":" \046\046 row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()
	for _, entry in self\046_overviewParts do
		if entry\046Hidden then
			if entry\046Part\046Parent then
				entry\046Part\046LocalTransparencyModifier = entry\046PreviousModifier
			end
			entry\046Hidden = false
		end
	end
	self\046_overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_invalidateOverview()
	if self\046_overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	self\046_overviewInvalid = true
	-- A changed footprint or ownership must never keep an old local coverage mask\046
	self:_showOverview()
	self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
end

function CornController:_restoreOverview()
	for _, connection in self\046_overviewConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table\046clear(self\046_overviewConnections)
	self\046_overviewInvalid = true
	self:_showOverview()
	self\046_overviewFolder = nil
	self\046_overviewRuntime = false
	self\046_overviewParts = {}
	self\046_overviewByChunk = {}
end

function CornController:_markOverviewChunk(key: string)
	for _, entry in self\046_overviewByChunk[key] or {} do
		self\046_overviewDirty[entry] = true
	end
end

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil
		and map ~= nil
		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder\046Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder\046Parent == map
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)
	then
		return false
	end
	-- The backdrop calls this before capturing authored visibility and publishing Ready\046
	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact\046
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self\046_pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	return true
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self\046_map
	local field = self\046_field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then
		folder = backdrop
	end
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	if
		not self\046_overviewInvalid
		and self\046_overviewFolder == folder
		and self\046_overviewFieldFrame == field\046CFrame
		and self\046_overviewFieldSize == field\046Size
	then
		return -- Signals invalidate the index instead of scanning every saved plant every poll\046
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	-- This pass does not yield or change visibility\046 The whole container must be owned\046
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self\046_overviewFolder = folder
	self\046_overviewRuntime = runtime
	self\046_overviewFieldFrame = field\046CFrame
	self\046_overviewFieldSize = field\046Size
	local function invalidate()
		self:_invalidateOverview()
	end
	local function watch(signal: RBXScriptSignal)
		table\046insert(self\046_overviewConnections, signal:Connect(invalidate))
	end
	watch(folder\046ChildAdded)
	watch(folder\046ChildRemoved)
	watch(folder\046AncestryChanged)
	watch(folder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))

function CornController:_lodForDistance(

	local dense = CornLayout\046DenseRadius

			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3

		else 0
