function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self\046_clock(), 0
	while
		self\046_pendingHead <= self\046_pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self\046_clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self\046_pending[self\046_pendingHead]
		self\046_pending[self\046_pendingHead] = nil
		self\046_pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self\046_pendingHead > self\046_pendingTail then
		self\046_pending, self\046_pendingHead, self\046_pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer\046Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group\046Connections)
	for plant in group\046Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer\046Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer\046Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder\046Parent ~= layer\046Folder
		or not folder\046Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer\046Groups[folder] = group
	table\046insert(
		group\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		group\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self\046_layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer\046Groups do
		disconnect(group\046Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer\046Connections)
	for _, entry in layer\046Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self\046_active[entry] = nil
	end
	self\046_layers[kind] = nil
	self\046_selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self\046_layers[kind]
	if previous and previous\046Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous\046Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self\046_layers[kind] = layer
	table\046insert(
		layer\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		layer\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table\046insert(
			layer\046Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for _, entry in layer\046Entries do
						self:_restore(entry)
						self\046_active[entry] = nil
					end
				end
				self\046_selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self\046_mapConnections)
	self\046_map = nil
	self\046_pending, self\046_pendingHead, self\046_pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self\046_map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self\046_map = map
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map\046AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self\046_map == map and map\046Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self\046_map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map\046ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item\046Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item\046Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map\046ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self\046_layers do
					if layer\046Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera, position: Vector3): boolean
	local delta = entry\046Position - position
	if delta\046X * delta\046X + delta\046Z * delta\046Z > RADIUS * RADIUS then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry\046Parts do
		if saved\046Part\046Transparency < 0\04699 and saved\046Part\046LocalTransparencyModifier < 0\04699 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry\046Position)
	return onScreen and screen\046Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_candidates(
	layer: any,
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	limit: number
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	local scanLimit = if layer\046Kind == "near" then 4096 else 1024
	for x = math\046floor((position\046X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math\046floor((position\046X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
		for z = math\046floor((position\046Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math\046floor((position\046Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for entry in layer\046Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
				scanned += 1
				if scanned > scanLimit then
					break
				end
				if self:_validEntry(entry) and visible(entry, camera, position) then
					local delta = entry\046Position - position
					table\046insert(
						result,
						{ Entry = entry, Distance = delta\046X * delta\046X + delta\046Z * delta\046Z }
					)
				end
			end
			if scanned > scanLimit then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > scanLimit then
			break
		end
	end
	self\046_lastScanned += math\046min(scanned, scanLimit)
	table\046sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math\046min(limit, #result) do
		table\046insert(selected, result[index]\046Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self\046_lastScanned = 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self\046_layers[kind]
		if
			layer
			and self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, kind)
			and (kind == "near" or layer\046Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == true)
		then
			for _, entry in
				self:_candidates(
					layer,
					camera,
					camera\046CFrame\046Position,
					if kind == "near" then NEAR_LIMIT else FAR_LIMIT
				)
			do
				table\046insert(chosen, entry)
				active[entry] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for entry in self\046_active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self\046_active, self\046_selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local began, writes, near, far = self\046_clock(), 0, 0, 0
	local count = #self\046_selected
	local cursor = self\046_animateCursor
	for offset = 0, count - 1 do
		local index = (cursor - 1 + offset) % count + 1
		local entry = self\046_selected[index]
		if self\046_clock() - began >= ANIMATE_SECONDS or writes + #entry\046Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		-- Resume after the last examined entry on the next tick\046 A tight time
		-- budget must not starve distant visible plants behind the near batch\046
		self\046_animateCursor = index % count + 1
		if
			not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry\046Layer\046Kind == "far" and entry\046Layer\046Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera, camera\046CFrame\046Position)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry\046Phase
		local displacement = entry\046Position - camera\046CFrame\046Position
		local strength = math\046clamp(
			(RADIUS - math\046sqrt(displacement\046X * displacement\046X + displacement\046Z * displacement\046Z))
				/ 12,
			0,
			1
		)
		local x = ANGLE
			* 0\04682
			* strength
			* (
				0\04672 * math\046sin(self\046_time * 1\0463 + phase)
				+ 0\04628 * math\046sin(self\046_time * 2\0461 + phase * 0\0467)
			)
		local z = ANGLE * 0\0465 * strength * math\046sin(self\046_time * 0\0469 + phase * 1\0464)
		local transform = CFrame\046new(entry\046Base) * CFrame\046Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame\046new(-entry\046Base)
		for _, saved in entry\046Parts do
			saved\046Part\046CFrame = transform * saved\046Frame
		end
		entry\046Moved = true
		writes += #entry\046Parts
		if entry\046Layer\046Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self\046_lastWrites, self\046_lastNear, self\046_lastFar = writes, near, far
	for kind, layer in self\046_layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, kind) then
			layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", if kind == "near" then near else far)
			layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self\046_mode or "off")
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "hard" then "hard" else nil
	if self\046_mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self\046_mode = nextMode
	self\046_animateCursor = 1
	self\046_updateElapsed, self\046_selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	if nextMode == nil then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self\046_lastWrites, self\046_lastNear, self\046_lastFar = 0, 0, 0
		for _, layer in self\046_layers do
			if self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, layer\046Kind) then
				layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
				layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self\046_time += math\046clamp(delta, 0, 0\04625)
	self\046_resolveElapsed += delta
	if self\046_resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self\046_resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if self\046_mode ~= "hard" then
		return
	end
	self\046_updateElapsed += delta
	self\046_selectElapsed += delta
	if self\046_updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self\046_updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace\046CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self\046_map
		or self\046_map\046Parent ~= Workspace
		or self\046_map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self\046_selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self\046_selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self\046_enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self\046_animateCursor = 1
	self\046_connection = nil
	self\046_clock = os\046clock
	self\046_map, self\046_mode = nil, nil
	self\046_layers, self\046_mapConnections, self\046_active, self\046_selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self\046_pending, self\046_pendingHead, self\046_pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self\046_time, self\046_resolveElapsed, self\046_updateElapsed, self\046_selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self\046_lastWrites, self\046_lastNear, self\046_lastFar, self\046_lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self\046_enabled = false
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController
"},source="--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CornWindController = { Name = "CornWindController", Order = 55 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local BUCKET_SIZE = 24
local RADIUS = 60
local UPDATE_SEC = 1 / 12
local SELECT_SEC = 0\04635
local RESOLVE_SEC = 0\0465
local INDEX_BUDGET = 64
local INDEX_SECONDS = 0\046001
local NEAR_LIMIT = 384
local FAR_LIMIT = 128
local PART_LIMIT = 512
local ANIMATE_SECONDS = 0\0460015
local MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT = 8
local ANGLE = math\046rad(1\0462)

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table\046clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part\046Anchored and not part\046CanCollide and not part\046CanTouch and not part\046CanQuery
end

local function bucketKey(x: number, z: number): string
	return tostring(x) \046\046 ":" \046\046 tostring(z)
end

function CornWindController:_ownedLayer(folder: Instance, kind: string): boolean
	return folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder\046Parent == self\046_map
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and (
			if kind == "near"
				then folder\046Name == "CornClientPlants" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientRendererOwned"
				) == true
				else folder\046Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		)
end

function CornWindController:_validEntry(entry: any): boolean
	local layer = entry\046Layer
	if
		self\046_layers[layer\046Kind] ~= layer
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, layer\046Kind)
		or entry\046Plant\046Parent ~= entry\046Parent
	then
		return false
	end
	if layer\046Kind == "near" then
		if
			entry\046Parent\046Parent ~= layer\046Folder
			or entry\046Plant\046Name ~= "Corn"
			or entry\046Plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return false
		end
	elseif
		entry\046Plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or entry\046Plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return false
	end
	for _, saved in entry\046Parts do
		if not decorative(saved\046Part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CornWindController:_restore(entry: any)
	if not entry\046Moved then
		return
	end
	-- Removed copies can still be unparented Instances\046 Restore their exact frames
	-- before forgetting them; destroyed copies need no recovery\046
	for _, saved in entry\046Parts do
		pcall(function()
			saved\046Part\046CFrame = saved\046Frame
		end)
	end
	entry\046Moved = false
end

function CornWindController:_restoreActive()
	for entry in self\046_active do
		self:_restore(entry)
	end
	self\046_active = {}
	self\046_selected = {}
end

function CornWindController:_remove(layer: any, plant: Instance)
	local entry = layer\046Entries[plant]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self:_restore(entry)
	self\046_active[entry] = nil
	layer\046Entries[plant] = nil
	layer\046Count -= 1
	local bucket = layer\046Buckets[entry\046Bucket]
	if bucket then
		bucket[entry] = nil
		if next(bucket) == nil then
			layer\046Buckets[entry\046Bucket] = nil
		end
	end
	local group = layer\046Groups[entry\046Parent]
	if group then
		group\046Entries[plant] = nil
	end
	self\046_selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_enqueue(layer: any, plant: Instance, parent: Instance)
	self\046_pendingTail += 1
	self\046_pending[self\046_pendingTail] = { Layer = layer, Plant = plant, Parent = parent }
end

function CornWindController:_register(job: any)
	local layer, plant, parent = job\046Layer, job\046Plant, job\046Parent
	if
		self\046_layers[layer\046Kind] ~= layer
		or layer\046Entries[plant]
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, layer\046Kind)
		or plant\046Parent ~= parent
	then
		return
	end
	if layer\046Kind == "near" then
		if
			not layer\046Groups[parent]
			or plant\046Name ~= "Corn"
			or plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return
		end
	elseif
		not plant\046Name:match("^Far_%-?%d+_%-?%d+$")
		or plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return
	end
	if layer\046Count >= (if layer\046Kind == "near" then 4096 else 20000) then
		return
	end
	local parts, frame, size = {}, nil, nil
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		if not decorative(plant) then
			return
		end
		table\046insert(parts, { Part = plant, Frame = plant\046CFrame })
		frame, size = plant\046CFrame, plant\046Size
	elseif plant:IsA("Model") then
		for _, part in plant:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if not decorative(part) or #parts >= MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT then
					return
				end
				table\046insert(parts, { Part = part, Frame = part\046CFrame })
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return
		end
		frame, size = plant:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		return
	end
	local position = frame\046Position
	local key =
		bucketKey(math\046floor(position\046X / BUCKET_SIZE), math\046floor(position\046Z / BUCKET_SIZE))
	local entry = {
		Layer = layer,
		Plant = plant,
		Parent = parent,
		Parts = parts,
		Position = position,
		Base = position - Vector3\046new(0, size\046Y / 2, 0),
		Bucket = key,
		Phase = (position\046X * 0\04617 + position\046Z * 0\04611) % (math\046pi * 2),
		Moved = false,
	}
	layer\046Entries[plant] = entry
	layer\046Count += 1
	if not layer\046Buckets[key] then
		layer\046Buckets[key] = {}
	end
	layer\046Buckets[key][entry] = true
	if layer\046Kind == "near" then
		layer\046Groups[parent]\046Entries[plant] = true
	end
	self\046_selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self\046_clock(), 0
	while
		self\046_pendingHead <= self\046_pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self\046_clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self\046_pending[self\046_pendingHead]
		self\046_pending[self\046_pendingHead] = nil
		self\046_pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self\046_pendingHead > self\046_pendingTail then
		self\046_pending, self\046_pendingHead, self\046_pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer\046Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group\046Connections)
	for plant in group\046Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer\046Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer\046Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder\046Parent ~= layer\046Folder
		or not folder\046Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer\046Groups[folder] = group
	table\046insert(
		group\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		group\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self\046_layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer\046Groups do
		disconnect(group\046Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer\046Connections)
	for _, entry in layer\046Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self\046_active[entry] = nil
	end
	self\046_layers[kind] = nil
	self\046_selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self\046_layers[kind]
	if previous and previous\046Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous\046Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self\046_layers[kind] = layer
	table\046insert(
		layer\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		layer\046Connections,
		folder\046ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table\046insert(
			layer\046Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for _, entry in layer\046Entries do
						self:_restore(entry)
						self\046_active[entry] = nil
					end
				end
				self\046_selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self\046_mapConnections)
	self\046_map = nil
	self\046_pending, self\046_pendingHead, self\046_pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self\046_map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self\046_map = map
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map\046AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self\046_map == map and map\046Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self\046_map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map\046ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item\046Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item\046Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table\046insert(
			self\046_mapConnections,
			map\046ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self\046_layers do
					if layer\046Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera, position: Vector3): boolean
	local delta = entry\046Position - position
	if delta\046X * delta\046X + delta\046Z * delta\046Z > RADIUS * RADIUS then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry\046Parts do
		if saved\046Part\046Transparency < 0\04699 and saved\046Part\046LocalTransparencyModifier < 0\04699 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry\046Position)
	return onScreen and screen\046Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_candidates(
	layer: any,
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	limit: number
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	local scanLimit = if layer\046Kind == "near" then 4096 else 1024
	for x = math\046floor((position\046X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math\046floor((position\046X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
		for z = math\046floor((position\046Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math\046floor((position\046Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for entry in layer\046Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
				scanned += 1
				if scanned > scanLimit then
					break
				end
				if self:_validEntry(entry) and visible(entry, camera, position) then
					local delta = entry\046Position - position
					table\046insert(
						result,
						{ Entry = entry, Distance = delta\046X * delta\046X + delta\046Z * delta\046Z }
					)
				end
			end
			if scanned > scanLimit then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > scanLimit then
			break
		end
	end
	self\046_lastScanned += math\046min(scanned, scanLimit)
	table\046sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a\046Distance < b\046Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math\046min(limit, #result) do
		table\046insert(selected, result[index]\046Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self\046_lastScanned = 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self\046_layers[kind]
		if
			layer
			and self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, kind)
			and (kind == "near" or layer\046Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == true)
		then
			for _, entry in
				self:_candidates(
					layer,
					camera,
					camera\046CFrame\046Position,
					if kind == "near" then NEAR_LIMIT else FAR_LIMIT
				)
			do
				table\046insert(chosen, entry)
				active[entry] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for entry in self\046_active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self\046_active, self\046_selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local began, writes, near, far = self\046_clock(), 0, 0, 0
	local count = #self\046_selected
	local cursor = self\046_animateCursor
	for offset = 0, count - 1 do
		local index = (cursor - 1 + offset) % count + 1
		local entry = self\046_selected[index]
		if self\046_clock() - began >= ANIMATE_SECONDS or writes + #entry\046Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		-- Resume after the last examined entry on the next tick\046 A tight time
		-- budget must not starve distant visible plants behind the near batch\046
		self\046_animateCursor = index % count + 1
		if
			not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry\046Layer\046Kind == "far" and entry\046Layer\046Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera, camera\046CFrame\046Position)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry\046Phase
		local displacement = entry\046Position - camera\046CFrame\046Position
		local strength = math\046clamp(
			(RADIUS - math\046sqrt(displacement\046X * displacement\046X + displacement\046Z * displacement\046Z))
				/ 12,
			0,
			1
		)
		local x = ANGLE
			* 0\04682
			* strength
			* (
				0\04672 * math\046sin(self\046_time * 1\0463 + phase)
				+ 0\04628 * math\046sin(self\046_time * 2\0461 + phase * 0\0467)
			)
		local z = ANGLE * 0\0465 * strength * math\046sin(self\046_time * 0\0469 + phase * 1\0464)
		local transform = CFrame\046new(entry\046Base) * CFrame\046Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame\046new(-entry\046Base)
		for _, saved in entry\046Parts do
			saved\046Part\046CFrame = transform * saved\046Frame
		end
		entry\046Moved = true
		writes += #entry\046Parts
		if entry\046Layer\046Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self\046_lastWrites, self\046_lastNear, self\046_lastFar = writes, near, far
	for kind, layer in self\046_layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, kind) then
			layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", if kind == "near" then near else far)
			layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self\046_mode or "off")
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "hard" then "hard" else nil
	if self\046_mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self\046_mode = nextMode
	self\046_animateCursor = 1
	self\046_updateElapsed, self\046_selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	if nextMode == nil then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self\046_lastWrites, self\046_lastNear, self\046_lastFar = 0, 0, 0
		for _, layer in self\046_layers do
			if self:_ownedLayer(layer\046Folder, layer\046Kind) then
				layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
				layer\046Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self\046_time += math\046clamp(delta, 0, 0\04625)
	self\046_resolveElapsed += delta
	if self\046_resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self\046_resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if self\046_mode ~= "hard" then
		return
	end
	self\046_updateElapsed += delta
	self\046_selectElapsed += delta
	if self\046_updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self\046_updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace\046CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self\046_map
		or self\046_map\046Parent ~= Workspace
		or self\046_map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self\046_selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self\046_selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self\046_enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self\046_animateCursor = 1
	self\046_connection = nil
	self\046_clock = os\046clock
	self\046_map, self\046_mode = nil, nil
	self\046_layers, self\046_mapConnections, self\046_active, self\046_selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self\046_pending, self\046_pendingHead, self\046_pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self\046_time, self\046_resolveElapsed, self\046_updateElapsed, self\046_selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self\046_lastWrites, self\046_lastNear, self\046_lastFar, self\046_lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self\046_connection = RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self\046_enabled = false
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController
"},

local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Builder = require(

)
local Controller = { Name = "FarmGeometryController", Order = 40 }
function Controller:Init(context: any)
	self\046_enabled = run:IsStudio()
		and context\046Config\046Environment == "DEV"
		and context\046Config\046Game\046SessionMode == "solo_local"
	self\046_runtime = Builder\046newRuntime("client")
	self\046_connections = {}
	self\046_parts = {}
	self\046_running = false
	self\046_queued = false
	self\046_pending = false
	self\046_started = false
end
function Controller:_schedule()
	if not self\046_enabled then
		return
	end
	if self\046_running then
		self\046_pending = true
		return
	end
	if self\046_queued then
		return
	end
	self\046_queued = true
	task\046defer(function()
		self\046_queued = false
		if self\046_enabled then
			self:_ensure()
		end
	end)
end
function Controller:_watch(part: Instance)
	if
		self\046_parts[part]
		or not part:IsA("MeshPart")
		or part:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") ~= true
	then
		return
	end
	local connection = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MeshContent"):Connect(function()
		self:_schedule()
	end)
	self\046_parts[part] = connection
end
function Controller:_ensure()
	self\046_running = true
	self\046_pending = false
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		self\046_runtime:Ensure()
	end)
	self\046_running = false
	if not ok then
		error("[FarmGeometryController] local rendering restoration failed: " \046\046 tostring(problem))
	end
	if self\046_pending then
		self:_schedule()
	end
end
function Controller:Start()
	if not self\046_enabled or self\046_started then
		return
	end
	self\046_started = true
	local map = world:WaitForChild("CornMap", 10)
	local props = map and map:FindFirstChild("Props")
	assert(props and props:IsA("Folder"), "Farm geometry client Props unavailable")
	for _, part in props:GetDescendants() do
		self:_watch(part)
	end
	table\046insert(
		self\046_connections,
		props\046DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
			self:_watch(part)
			self:_schedule()
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		self\046_connections,
		props\046DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(part)
			local connection = self\046_parts[part]
			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
				self\046_parts[part] = nil
			end
		end)
	)
	self:_ensure()
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	self\046_enabled = false
	for _, connection in self\046_connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	for _, connection in self\046_parts do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self\046_connections = {}
	self\046_parts = {}
	self\046_runtime:Destroy()
end
return Controller

local function eligible(snapshot: any): boolean

function GateHintController:_show(visible: boolean)

	self\046_snapshot = snapshot
	if not eligible(snapshot) then

function GateHintController:_gatePosition(): Vector3?
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if not gate or not gate:IsA("Model") or not gate:HasTag("corn_gate") then
		return nil
	end
	local anchor = gate:FindFirstChild("InteractionAnchor")
	return if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then anchor\046Position else nil
end

function GateHintController:_canShow(position: Vector3?, anchor: Vector3?, alive: boolean): boolean
	if not eligible(self\046_snapshot) or not alive or not position or not anchor then
		return false
	end
	local delta = position - anchor
	local radius = if self\046_shown then EXIT_RADIUS else ENTER_RADIUS
	return math\046abs(delta\046Y) <= HEIGHT_TOLERANCE
		and delta\046X * delta\046X + delta\046Z * delta\046Z <= radius * radius
end

function GateHintController:_update()
	local position = nil
	local alive = false
	local character = player\046Character
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid\046Health > 0 then
		position = root\046Position
		alive = true
	end
	self:_show(self:_canShow(position, self:_gatePosition(), alive))
	local camera = workspace\046CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		local topLeft, bottomRight = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		local viewport = camera\046ViewportSize - topLeft - bottomRight
		self\046_scale\046Scale = math\046min(1, math\046max(0\0461, (viewport\046X - 24) / PANEL_WIDTH))
	end
end

function GateHintController:Start(_context: any)
	if self\046_connection then
		return
	end
	self\046_connection = RunService\046RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
		self\046_elapsed += dt
		if self\046_elapsed >= UPDATE_INTERVAL then
			self\046_elapsed = 0
			self:_update()
		end
	end)
end

function GateHintController:Destroy()
	if self\046_connection then
		self\046_connection:Disconnect()
		self\046_connection = nil
	end
	self:_show(false)
	if self\046_gui then
		self\046_gui:Destroy()
		self\046_gui = nil
	end
	self\046_snapshot = nil
end

return GateHintController
"},

function MinimapController:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)

	self\046_active\046Visible = isActive

	self\046_retry\046Visible = isResult

		self\046_message\046Text = if phase == "caught"

				else "corn_loop_result_aborted"
		)
		self\046_message\046Text = if phase == "escaped"
			then text("corn_loop_reward", { count = snapshot\046reward_diamonds })
			else ""

	self\046_activeNotice\046Text = ""

	if snapshot and isActive then
		local objectiveKey = if snapshot\046gate_open
			then "corn_loop_objective_exit"
			elseif snapshot\046has_key then "corn_loop_objective_return"
			else "corn_loop_objective_search"
		self\046_objective\046Text = text(objectiveKey)

		self\046_activeNotice\046Text = if snapshot\046protection_sec > 0
			then text("corn_hunt_protected", { seconds = math\046ceil(snapshot\046protection_sec) })

    if item then
        assert(item.ClassName==entry.class,"Object collision; nothing changed: "..entry.path)
        assert(editor:FindScriptDocument(item)==nil,"Close script tab; nothing changed: "..entry.path)
        local recognized=normalized(item.Source)==normalized(entry.source) or (entry.baseline and normalized(item.Source)==normalized(entry.baseline))
        for _,oldSource in entry.history do recognized=recognized or normalized(item.Source)==normalized(oldSource) end
        assert(recognized,"Manual Source edit; nothing changed: "..entry.path)
    else
        assert(entry.allowMissing==true and entry.baseline==nil and entry.class=="ModuleScript","Missing baseline code; nothing changed: "..entry.path)
    end
end
local allowed={}
for _,entry in entries do local item=resolve(entry.path);if item then allowed[item]=true end end
for _,path in {"ReplicatedStorage/GameShared","ServerScriptService/GameServer","StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameClient"} do

        table.insert(created,dataFolder); dataFolder.Parent=resolve("ReplicatedStorage/GameShared/Game")

end)
